name: 反商业贿赂合规制度设计
description_zh: 生成反商业贿赂合规制度文件（多文件DOCX+XLSX）。触发：反贿赂合规制度搭建/反腐败合规手册编制/ISO 37001制度建立。不触发：第三方尽调单案/东道国法规汇编/贸易合规风险初评——调用对应专项技能。
description_en:
Generate anti-commercial bribery compliance document packages (multi-file DOCX + XLSX).
Trigger Conditions: Establishment of anti-bribery compliance systems, formulation of anti-corruption compliance manuals, development of ISO 37001 management systems.
Non-trigger Scenarios: Single-case third-party due diligence, host country regulation compilation, preliminary trade compliance risk assessment — invoke corresponding specialized skills.
